import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, rename columns to match target schema, and collect
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Rename 'J_CALL' to 'V_GENE' to match target schema
        df_renamed = df.rename(columns={"J_CALL": "V_GENE"})
        dfs.append(df_renamed)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is only ['V_GENE'], so ensure only that column is present
    target_df = target_df[['V_GENE']]

    # Write the result to the specified output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
